features.feature: Evidence activation policy and threshold contract
features.covered_by: CHK-001 plus understanding constraints require candidate status, recommend_activate, decisive helped/dismissed/harmful denominator, exposure, structured verdict source, lineage audit posture, digest binding, idempotency, and rollback semantics.

features.feature: Real guarded evidence activation writer, not another fake default-off guard
features.covered_by: CHK-002 and decision chosen=evidence-activated-apply require playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply to activate evidence-eligible candidates under reviewed policy and remove the activationImplemented=false/always-off blocker for ordinary CLI use.
Understanding facts/constraints and CHK-002 require authority non_authoritative, gateEvidence false, audit-only advisory activation, and no lifecycle gate satisfaction from playbooks.

features.feature: Story DONE alone never activates playbooks
features.covered_by: CHK-001 and CHK-004 explicitly exclude DONE success from promotion denominators and require negative fixtures proving story DONE cannot activate a candidate.

features.feature: Demotion, rollback, audit provenance, digest binding, and idempotency
features.covered_by: CHK-002/CHK-003 plus decision pre-mortem require append-only audit, current digest checks, idempotent re-apply, distinct manual vs auto provenance, and reversible advisory activation without deleting evidence.

features.feature: End-to-end and adversarial proof of evidence-driven activation
features.covered_by: CHK-004 requires seed/proposal/candidate, explicit exposure/outcome, recommend_activate sweep, lineage check, dry-run eligibility, guarded apply activation, runtime consumption verification, and negative missing-policy/evidence/stale/duplicate/DONE fixtures.

features.excluded_by: scope-boundary excluded Default-on automatic activation; decision rejects blanket-auto-active.

features.feature: Using playbooks as lifecycle gate evidence
features.excluded_by: scope-boundary excludes treating playbooks as lifecycle gate evidence; understanding says learning artifacts are advisory and non-authoritative.

features.feature: Using story DONE success as helped evidence
features.excluded_by: scope-boundary excludes using story DONE as helped evidence; checklist requires negative fixtures proving DONE cannot activate.
